subject: Onboarding approval matrix and term uplift — procurement portal steps
messages:
From: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@acmecloud.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01 09:12 AM -0700
Subject: Renewal procurement — onboarding evidence and approval timeline

Hi Jordan,

We kicked off the renewal review in procurement today. Two asks from our side before we can proceed with the PO lane: 1) an up-to-date vendor evidence bundle (SOC2 summary, data flow diagrams, retention policy) and 2) confirmation of the proposed capacity increase — our platform team is asking for committed QPS and peak token/day numbers for the next 12-24 months.

Also: our procurement portal requires a vendor onboarding refresh for any term change or capacity uplift (it routes to procurement > security > legal). Is there a standard evidence checklist you can send? We have an internal deadline to get approvals routed by July 12 so we can align to our fiscal cadence.

Thanks — if easier, copy our procurement mailbox (procurement@acmecloud.com) and I can create the internal ticket.

Best,
Lisa
Lisa Moreno
Procurement Manager, Acme Cloudware
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Lisa Moreno <lisa.moreno@acmecloud.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-01 10:03 AM -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal procurement — onboarding evidence and approval timeline

Hi Lisa — thanks for the heads up and the deadline. We can do both items on an accelerated cadence. High-level plan below (happy to jump on a 30-min call today):

- Evidence bundle: attached a concise checklist (onboarding-evidence-checklist.pdf). We will provide SOC2 summary, DSP/retention note, architecture/data flow SVG, and a short SAML/SAML2 integration guide for your SSO team.
- Capacity uplift: proposed tiers in attached spreadsheet (proposed-multiphase-plan.xlsx). Our recommendation is a phased uplift: 1) +30% committed capacity for months 1–6, 2) +50% committed (and reserved burst) months 7–24. This reduces immediate spend risk while giving you guaranteed throughput.
- Portal onboarding: if you send procurement@acmecloud.com the link / ticket ID we'll populate the evidence bundle and add a short comment about the term change (propose 24 months to keep unit economics stable).

Next steps I suggest: you create the procurement ticket, we upload the evidence folder to a shared Drive, we send an amended SOW for signature (DocuSign), and your legal can redline. I can own the SOW/procurement lane and loop in Marissa for any contract-level exceptions.

Available: today 2:00–4:00 PM PDT or tomorrow 9:00–11:00 AM PDT.

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Thanks — quick pricing note from our side so procurement has the right ask: the uplift pricing below assumes a 24-month term with a tiered commit structure (Tier A baseline, Tier B reserved burst). If Acme prefers a 12-month term we can do it but unit price will be ~18% higher for the uplift tranche.

Deal: RDW-DEAL-2028-467
Requested uplift: +50% reserved capacity (peak) by month 7
Suggested term: 24 months (recommended)
Finance is ready to fast-track once procurement confirms the PO lane and sends through the vendor form. Jordan — I'll prepare a short pricing summary to attach to your SOW (ETA EOD).

-Karthik

Jordan — thanks for the plan. I opened an internal request and attached our vendor onboarding form (acme_req_form_v3.xlsx). A few clarifications from procurement/security:

1) We need a signed SOC2 (or SOC2 summary + auditor letter) and the latest penetration-test summary.
2) Data retention policy required for EU data (if any) — that will route to our privacy team.
3) Please fill section 4 (third-party subprocessors) in the attached onboarding form.

We will create an approval matrix during routing (Procurement -> Security -> Legal -> Finance). Please note: any term extension greater than 12 months will require Senior Legal sign-off (our process). I have filed HubSpot ticket HS-78910 to track — I will update that record with the DocuSign link once we receive the amended SOW.
